ElementInput.description:
Element input for image generation with face/character control.

Create an element by providing frontal_image_url (and optionally reference_image_urls).
All fields are optional - provide what you have available.

anyOf.limit_description: Max file size: 10.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

frontal_image_url.description: The frontal image of the element (main view). Optional.
frontal_image_url.title: Frontal Image Url

items.limit_description: Max file size: 10.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

reference_image_urls.description: Additional reference images from different angles. 0-3 images supported. Optional.
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls

ElementInput.title: ElementInput

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.
height.title: Height

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
width.title: Width

KlingImageO3ImageToImageInput.description: Request model for Kling O3 Image-to-Image Generation.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of generated images. 'auto' intelligently determines based on input content.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

elements.description: Optional: Elements (characters/objects) for face control. Reference in prompt as @Element1, @Element2, etc.
elements.title: Elements

image_urls.description: List of reference images. Reference images in prompt using @Image1, @Image2, etc. (1-indexed). Max 10 images.

items.limit_description: Max file size: 10.0MB, Min width: 300px, Min height: 300px, Min aspect ratio: 0.40, Max aspect ratio: 2.50, Timeout: 20.0s

image_urls.title: Image Urls

num_images.description: Number of images to generate (1-9). Only used when result_type is 'single'.
num_images.title: Num Images

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation. Reference images using @Image1, @Image2, etc. (or @Image if only one image). Max 2500 characters.
examples: Transform into photorealistic 3D render, add proper lighting and shadows, realistic materials and textures, maintain exact proportions and design from sketch, product visualization quality
prompt.title: Prompt

resolution.description: Image generation resolution. 1K: standard, 2K: high-res, 4K: ultra high-res.
resolution.title: Resolution

result_type.description: Result type. 'single' for one image, 'series' for a series of related images.
result_type.title: Result Type

series_amount.description: Number of images in series (2-9). Only used when result_type is 'series'.
series_amount.title: Series Amount

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

KlingImageO3ImageToImageInput.title: O3ImageToImageRequest

KlingImageO3ImageToImageOutput.description: Output model for Kling O3 Image Generation.
KlingImageO3ImageToImageOutput.title: I2IO3ImageOutput
